comment:
Continuity of `f` at a point `c ∈ S` (relative to `S`) is equivalent to the classical
`ε`-`δ` formulation: for every `ε > 0` there is `δ > 0` such that for all `x ∈ S`,
`|x - c| < δ` implies `|f x - f c| < ε`.
formal_statement:
theorem continuous_at_iff_eps_delta (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (c : ℝ) (_hc : c ∈ S) :
    ContinuousWithinAt f S c ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x ∈ S, |x - c| < δ → |f x - f c| < ε
proof_code:
:= by
  rw [Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff]
  simp only [Real.dist_eq]

/-- `IsBoundedOn f S` states that `f` is bounded on `S`: there exists a nonnegative real
number `B` such that `|f x| ≤ B` for every `x ∈ S`. -/
raw_declaration:
theorem continuous_at_iff_eps_delta (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (c : ℝ) (_hc : c ∈ S) :
    ContinuousWithinAt f S c ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x ∈ S, |x - c| < δ → |f x - f c| < ε := by
  rw [Metric.continuousWithinAt_iff]
  simp only [Real.dist_eq]

/-- `IsBoundedOn f S` states that `f` is bounded on `S`: there exists a nonnegative real

comment:
A real-valued function that is continuous on a closed bounded interval `[a, b]` is bounded:
there exists `B ∈ ℝ` such that `|f x| ≤ B` for all `x ∈ [a, b]`.
formal_statement:
theorem continuous_on_Icc_bounded (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (_hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |f x| ≤ B
proof_code:
:= by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf
  exact ⟨C, fun x hx => by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hC x hx⟩

/-- Extreme Value (Min-Max) Theorem: a continuous function on a closed bounded interval `[a, b]`
attains both an absolute minimum at some point `c ∈ [a, b]` and an absolute maximum at some
point `d ∈ [a, b]`. -/
raw_declaration:
theorem continuous_on_Icc_bounded (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (_hab : a ≤ b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    ∃ B : ℝ, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, |f x| ≤ B := by
  obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn hf
  exact ⟨C, fun x hx => by rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact hC x hx⟩

/-- Extreme Value (Min-Max) Theorem: a continuous function on a closed bounded interval `[a, b]`
attains both an absolute minimum at some point `c ∈ [a, b]` and an absolute maximum at some
point `d ∈ [a, b]`. -/

comment:

attains both an absolute minimum at some point `c ∈ [a, b]` and an absolute maximum at some

formal_statement:
theorem extreme_value_theorem (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    (∃ c ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f c ≤ f x) ∧
    (∃ d ∈ Set.Icc a b, ∀ x ∈ Set.Icc a b, f x ≤ f d)

  have hne : (Set.Icc a b).Nonempty := Set.nonempty_Icc.mpr (le_of_lt hab)

comment:
Bolzano's Intermediate Value Theorem.

Let `f : ℝ → ℝ` be continuous on `[a, b]` with `a < b`. Then:
if `f a < y < f b`, there exists `c ∈ (a, b)` with `f c = y`;
if `f b < y < f a`, there exists `c ∈ (a, b)` with `f c = y`.

In either case, `f` attains every value strictly between `f a` and `f b` at some
interior point of the interval.
formal_statement:
theorem intermediate_value_theorem (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    (∀ y, f a < y → y < f b → ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo a b, f c = y) ∧
    (∀ y, f b < y → y < f a → ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo a b, f c = y)
proof_code:
:= by
  have hab' : a ≤ b := le_of_lt hab
  constructor
  · intro y hy1 hy2
    have hy_mem : y ∈ Icc (f a) (f b) := ⟨le_of_lt hy1, le_of_lt hy2⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc_mem, hfc⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hab' hf hy_mem
    refine ⟨c, ?_, hfc⟩
    constructor
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc_mem.1 with h | h
      · exfalso; linarith [hfc ▸ h ▸ hy1]
      · exact h
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc_mem.2 with h | h
      · exfalso; linarith [hfc ▸ h ▸ hy2]
      · exact h
  · intro y hy1 hy2
    have hy_mem : y ∈ Icc (f b) (f a) := ⟨le_of_lt hy1, le_of_lt hy2⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc_mem, hfc⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' hab' hf hy_mem
    refine ⟨c, ?_, hfc⟩
    constructor
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc_mem.1 with h | h
      · exfalso; linarith [hfc ▸ h ▸ hy2]
      · exact h
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc_mem.2 with h | h
      · exfalso; linarith [hfc ▸ h ▸ hy1]
      · exact h

/-- The polynomial `f(x) = x^2021 + x^2020 + 9.03 x + 1` has at least one real
root.

Proved via the Intermediate Value Theorem: `f(-1) < 0` and `f(0) > 0`, so by
continuity there exists `c ∈ [-1, 0]` with `f(c) = 0`. -/
raw_declaration:
theorem intermediate_value_theorem (f : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b)
    (hf : ContinuousOn f (Set.Icc a b)) :
    (∀ y, f a < y → y < f b → ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo a b, f c = y) ∧
    (∀ y, f b < y → y < f a → ∃ c ∈ Set.Ioo a b, f c = y) := by
  have hab' : a ≤ b := le_of_lt hab
  constructor
  · intro y hy1 hy2
    have hy_mem : y ∈ Icc (f a) (f b) := ⟨le_of_lt hy1, le_of_lt hy2⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc_mem, hfc⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc hab' hf hy_mem
    refine ⟨c, ?_, hfc⟩
    constructor
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc_mem.1 with h | h
      · exfalso; linarith [hfc ▸ h ▸ hy1]
      · exact h
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc_mem.2 with h | h
      · exfalso; linarith [hfc ▸ h ▸ hy2]
      · exact h
  · intro y hy1 hy2
    have hy_mem : y ∈ Icc (f b) (f a) := ⟨le_of_lt hy1, le_of_lt hy2⟩
    obtain ⟨c, hc_mem, hfc⟩ := intermediate_value_Icc' hab' hf hy_mem
    refine ⟨c, ?_, hfc⟩
    constructor
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc_mem.1 with h | h
      · exfalso; linarith [hfc ▸ h ▸ hy2]
      · exact h
    · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hc_mem.2 with h | h
      · exfalso; linarith [hfc ▸ h ▸ hy1]
      · exact h

/-- The polynomial `f(x) = x^2021 + x^2020 + 9.03 x + 1` has at least one real
root.

Proved via the Intermediate Value Theorem: `f(-1) < 0` and `f(0) > 0`, so by
continuity there exists `c ∈ [-1, 0]` with `f(c) = 0`. -/

comment:
The polynomial `f(x) = x^2021 + x^2020 + 9.03 x + 1` has at least one real
root.

Proved via the Intermediate Value Theorem: `f(-1) < 0` and `f(0) > 0`, so by
continuity there exists `c ∈ [-1, 0]` with `f(c) = 0`.
formal_statement: theorem polynomial_has_real_root : ∃ x : ℝ, x^2021 + x^2020 + 9.03*x + 1 = 0
proof_code:
:= by

  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x^2021 + x^2020 + 9.03*x + 1

  have hf_cont : Continuous f := by fun_prop

  have hf_neg : f (-1) < 0 := by norm_num [f]

  have hf_pos : (0 : ℝ) < f 0 := by norm_num [f]

  have hab : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by norm_num
  have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (f (-1)) (f 0) :=
    ⟨le_of_lt hf_neg, le_of_lt hf_pos⟩
  have h_ivt := intermediate_value_Icc hab hf_cont.continuousOn h0_mem
  obtain ⟨c, _, hfc⟩ := h_ivt
  exact ⟨c, hfc⟩

end ContinuousFunctions
raw_declaration:
theorem polynomial_has_real_root : ∃ x : ℝ, x^2021 + x^2020 + 9.03*x + 1 = 0 := by

  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => x^2021 + x^2020 + 9.03*x + 1

  have hf_cont : Continuous f := by fun_prop

  have hf_neg : f (-1) < 0 := by norm_num [f]

  have hf_pos : (0 : ℝ) < f 0 := by norm_num [f]

  have hab : (-1 : ℝ) ≤ 0 := by norm_num
  have h0_mem : (0 : ℝ) ∈ Icc (f (-1)) (f 0) :=
    ⟨le_of_lt hf_neg, le_of_lt hf_pos⟩
  have h_ivt := intermediate_value_Icc hab hf_cont.continuousOn h0_mem
  obtain ⟨c, _, hfc⟩ := h_ivt
  exact ⟨c, hfc⟩

end ContinuousFunctions

comment:
The elementary `ε`-`δ` notion `IsClusterPoint S x` agrees with Mathlib's
topological accumulation point `AccPt x (𝓟 S)`.
formal_statement:
theorem cluster_point_iff_acc_point (S : Set ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    IsClusterPoint S x ↔ AccPt x (𝓟 S)
proof_code:
:= by
  rw [accPt_iff_nhds]
  constructor
  · intro h U hU
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU
    obtain ⟨y, hyS, hyx, habs⟩ := h ε hε
    refine ⟨y, ⟨?_, hyS⟩, hyx⟩
    apply hball
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
    linarith [abs_sub_comm y x]
  · intro h δ hδ
    obtain ⟨y, ⟨hyU, hyS⟩, hyx⟩ := h _ (Metric.ball_mem_nhds x hδ)
    refine ⟨y, hyS, hyx, ?_⟩
    have := Metric.mem_ball.mp hyU
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at this
    linarith [abs_sub_comm y x]

/-- `f` converges to `L` at `c` along `S`, written informally `f(x) → L` as `x → c`,
if for every `ε > 0` there exists `δ > 0` such that for all `x ∈ S` with
`0 < |x - c| < δ` one has `|f x - L| < ε`. -/
raw_declaration:
theorem cluster_point_iff_acc_point (S : Set ℝ) (x : ℝ) :
    IsClusterPoint S x ↔ AccPt x (𝓟 S) := by
  rw [accPt_iff_nhds]
  constructor
  · intro h U hU
    obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.mp hU
    obtain ⟨y, hyS, hyx, habs⟩ := h ε hε
    refine ⟨y, ⟨?_, hyS⟩, hyx⟩
    apply hball
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq]
    linarith [abs_sub_comm y x]
  · intro h δ hδ
    obtain ⟨y, ⟨hyU, hyS⟩, hyx⟩ := h _ (Metric.ball_mem_nhds x hδ)
    refine ⟨y, hyS, hyx, ?_⟩
    have := Metric.mem_ball.mp hyU
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at this
    linarith [abs_sub_comm y x]

/-- `f` converges to `L` at `c` along `S`, written informally `f(x) → L` as `x → c`,
if for every `ε > 0` there exists `δ > 0` such that for all `x ∈ S` with
`0 < |x - c| < δ` one has `|f x - L| < ε`. -/

comment:
The elementary `ε`-`δ` definition `FunctionConvergesAt f S c L` is equivalent
to the Mathlib filter statement that `f` tends to `L` along the neighborhood
filter of `c` restricted to `S \ {c}`.
formal_statement:
theorem function_limit_iff_tendsto (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (c L : ℝ) :
    FunctionConvergesAt f S c L ↔
    Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin c (S \ {c})) (nhds L)
proof_code:
:= by
  rw [Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds]
  constructor
  · intro h ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hfx⟩ := h ε hε
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun {x} hxmem hdist => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hdist ⊢
    exact hfx x hxmem.1 (abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hxmem.2)) hdist
  · intro h ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hfx⟩ := h ε hε
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun x hxS hpos hdist => ?_⟩
    have hxc : x ≠ c := by
      intro heq
      simp [heq] at hpos
    have hxmem : x ∈ S \ {c} := ⟨hxS, hxc⟩
    have hdist' : dist x c < δ := by rwa [Real.dist_eq]
    have := hfx hxmem hdist'
    rwa [Real.dist_eq] at this

/-- The right-hand limit `f(x) → L` as `x → c⁺` along `S`: for every `ε > 0`
there exists `δ > 0` such that for all `x ∈ S` with `c < x < c + δ` one has
`|f x - L| < ε`. -/
raw_declaration:
theorem function_limit_iff_tendsto (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (c L : ℝ) :
    FunctionConvergesAt f S c L ↔
    Filter.Tendsto f (nhdsWithin c (S \ {c})) (nhds L) := by
  rw [Metric.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhds]
  constructor
  · intro h ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hfx⟩ := h ε hε
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun {x} hxmem hdist => ?_⟩
    rw [Real.dist_eq] at hdist ⊢
    exact hfx x hxmem.1 (abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hxmem.2)) hdist
  · intro h ε hε
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hfx⟩ := h ε hε
    refine ⟨δ, hδ, fun x hxS hpos hdist => ?_⟩
    have hxc : x ≠ c := by
      intro heq
      simp [heq] at hpos
    have hxmem : x ∈ S \ {c} := ⟨hxS, hxc⟩
    have hdist' : dist x c < δ := by rwa [Real.dist_eq]
    have := hfx hxmem hdist'
    rwa [Real.dist_eq] at this

/-- The right-hand limit `f(x) → L` as `x → c⁺` along `S`: for every `ε > 0`
there exists `δ > 0` such that for all `x ∈ S` with `c < x < c + δ` one has
`|f x - L| < ε`. -/

comment:
Uniqueness of the function limit: if `c` is a cluster point of `S` and `f`
converges both to `L₁` and to `L₂` at `c` along `S`, then `L₁ = L₂`.
formal_statement:
theorem function_limit_unique (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (c L₁ L₂ : ℝ)
    (hc : IsClusterPoint S c)
    (hL₁ : FunctionConvergesAt f S c L₁)
    (hL₂ : FunctionConvergesAt f S c L₂) : L₁ = L₂
proof_code:
:= by
  have hne : (nhdsWithin c (S \ {c})).NeBot := by
    rwa [← accPt_principal_iff_nhdsWithin, ← cluster_point_iff_acc_point]
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique
    ((function_limit_iff_tendsto f S c L₁).mp hL₁)
    ((function_limit_iff_tendsto f S c L₂).mp hL₂)

end ContinuousFunctions
raw_declaration:
theorem function_limit_unique (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) (c L₁ L₂ : ℝ)
    (hc : IsClusterPoint S c)
    (hL₁ : FunctionConvergesAt f S c L₁)
    (hL₂ : FunctionConvergesAt f S c L₂) : L₁ = L₂ := by
  have hne : (nhdsWithin c (S \ {c})).NeBot := by
    rwa [← accPt_principal_iff_nhdsWithin, ← cluster_point_iff_acc_point]
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique
    ((function_limit_iff_tendsto f S c L₁).mp hL₁)
    ((function_limit_iff_tendsto f S c L₂).mp hL₂)

end ContinuousFunctions

comment:
A real function `f` is uniformly continuous on a set `S ⊆ ℝ` if and only if it
satisfies the textbook ε–δ criterion: for every `ε > 0` there exists `δ > 0` such
that `|f x - f y| < ε` for all `x, y ∈ S` with `|x - y| < δ`.
formal_statement:
theorem uniform_continuous_on_iff (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) :
    UniformContinuousOn f S ↔
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, |x - y| < δ → |f x - f y| < ε
proof_code:
:= by
  simp only [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff, Real.dist_eq]

end Real_Analysis
raw_declaration:
theorem uniform_continuous_on_iff (f : ℝ → ℝ) (S : Set ℝ) :
    UniformContinuousOn f S ↔
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ δ > 0, ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, |x - y| < δ → |f x - f y| < ε := by
  simp only [Metric.uniformContinuousOn_iff, Real.dist_eq]

end Real_Analysis

comment:
A real function `f` is differentiable at `c` if and only if the difference quotient
`(f x - f c) / (x - c)` has a limit as `x → c` with `x ≠ c`.
formal_statement:
theorem differentiable_at_iff_limit_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ f c ↔
    ∃ L : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun x => (f x - f c) / (x - c)) (nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ) (nhds L)
proof_code:
:= by
  constructor
  · intro hd
    exact ⟨deriv f c, by rw [show (fun x => (f x - f c) / (x - c)) = slope f c from
      (slope_fun_def_field f c).symm]; exact hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp hd.hasDerivAt⟩
  · rintro ⟨L, hL⟩
    have hslope : Filter.Tendsto (slope f c) (nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ) (nhds L) := by
      rwa [show (fun x => (f x - f c) / (x - c)) = slope f c from
        (slope_fun_def_field f c).symm] at hL
    exact (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mpr hslope).differentiableAt

/-- Chain rule: if `g` is differentiable at `c` and `f` is differentiable at `g c`,
then the composition `f ∘ g` is differentiable at `c` and
`(f ∘ g)'(c) = f'(g c) * g'(c)`. -/
raw_declaration:
theorem differentiable_at_iff_limit_exists (f : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ) :
    DifferentiableAt ℝ f c ↔
    ∃ L : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun x => (f x - f c) / (x - c)) (nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ) (nhds L) := by
  constructor
  · intro hd
    exact ⟨deriv f c, by rw [show (fun x => (f x - f c) / (x - c)) = slope f c from
      (slope_fun_def_field f c).symm]; exact hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp hd.hasDerivAt⟩
  · rintro ⟨L, hL⟩
    have hslope : Filter.Tendsto (slope f c) (nhdsWithin c {c}ᶜ) (nhds L) := by
      rwa [show (fun x => (f x - f c) / (x - c)) = slope f c from
        (slope_fun_def_field f c).symm] at hL
    exact (hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mpr hslope).differentiableAt

/-- Chain rule: if `g` is differentiable at `c` and `f` is differentiable at `g c`,
then the composition `f ∘ g` is differentiable at `c` and
`(f ∘ g)'(c) = f'(g c) * g'(c)`. -/
